filters.comment: X-Content-Type-Options is verified out-of-band by the custom Nuclei baseline template (sentinel-security-headers.yaml). Kept here so ZAP's passive scanner does not double-report noise while the assertion stays enforced by a test that actually fails loudly.
CSP is default-src 'none' for the API surface (no browser-rendered content); ZAP reports a false-positive on JSON API bodies.
